summary: United States Natural Gas Fund, LP filed an 8-K reporting that affiliate sponsor The Marygold Companies, Inc. (TMC) entered a definitive agreement with Madison Dearborn Partners (MDP) to take TMC private in an all-cash transaction. TMC is the sole shareholder of USCF Investments, the sole member of United States Commodity Funds LLC, the registrant's general partner. Closing is expected in 1H 2027, subject to TMC stockholder approval, regulatory and change-of-control consents; TMC shares would delist from NYSE. UNG itself is not acquired; watch GP change-of-control consents, potential strategy shift at USCF, and timing risk.
